messages.content:
공개 ACCEPTANCE.md, src/duration.py, 인수 테스트를 읽고 수정 계획을 NOTES.md에 기록한다.
인수 조건과 테스트는 바꾸지 않는다.
매 작업 결과에 narrative, open_issue_ids, info_items를 제공한다.
open_issue_ids는 현재 전체 미해결 쟁점 ID, info_items는 이번 작업의 새 정보다.
새 정보가 없으면 빈 목록이다. 상태를 모르면 null을 제공한다. completion_declared는 false다.

Use tools to inspect/edit the actual workspace. Available tool vocabulary is read_file, write_file, replace_in_file, run_tests. For THIS role only these tools are registered: read_file, write_file, replace_in_file. Call only this role's registered tools. Do not call any other tool, including print_tree. For directory structure use monitored_paths in the context. To change an existing file, use replace_in_file with a short unique old snippet; do not rewrite a whole file in one write_file call, and split large edits into several calls. In Python code do not write docstrings and use ASCII characters only (no Unicode punctuation such as U+2011 non-breaking hyphen). Files this role can write: NOTES.md. Each step allows at most 3 model calls for this role; the last call of a step has no tools and returns the final report. Final response must be one JSON object matching this schema. Report the full shared state, not only this role's issues. Never claim tests passed without running them.
